name: How long does it take to repair a drywall crack?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a drywall crack?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of drywall crack repair depends on the crack's severity and size. A small hairline crack might take a few hours for preparation, patching, and initial drying, often completed within a single day. Larger or more complex repairs, especially those requiring multiple layers of compound and drying times between coats, could extend over 1-2 days, with final painting typically done after the repair is fully cured.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small crack repairs can take a few hours to a day. Larger, more complex cracks requiring multiple coats and drying time may take 1-2 days.
